name: Gryt Server
author: 138704619+wan0v@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Gryt is an open source voice, video and text chat platform.

Connect with the Gryt desktop app or the hosted web client at https://app.gryt.chat.
The first user to join becomes the owner; afterwards the server is invite-only.

Requirements:
- amd64 only (the Gryt Linux bundle is x64 only)
- needs two extra allocations: one for the SFU websocket (set SFU_PORT to its port), one for voice
media (set ICE_UDP_MUX_PORT to its port)
- set SFU_PUBLIC_HOST to <public-ip>:<SFU_PORT> so voice works over the internet

startup.label: Default
startup.command: export SERVER_VERSION="$(node -p "require(process.argv[1]).version" ./server/package.json)"; if [ -z "$JWT_SECRET" ]; then [ -f .jwt_secret ] || head -c 48 /dev/urandom | base64 > .jwt_secret; export JWT_SECRET="$(cat .jwt_secret)"; fi; ./gryt_sfu & if [ "$IMAGE_WORKER_ENABLED" != "false" ]; then node --env-file=config.env image-worker/dist/index.js & fi; exec node --env-file=config.env server/dist/index.js

variables.name: Gryt Version
variables.description: The Gryt Server version to install (e.g. 1.6.5 or latest). Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Secret for session tokens. Leave empty to auto-generate a persistent one on first start.

variables.name: SFU Port
variables.description: TCP port of the voice SFU websocket. Must match an extra port allocation.

variables.name: SFU Public Host
variables.description: Public address of the SFU given to clients, e.g. 203.0.113.10:5005 or sfu.example.com:5005 (wss://... behind a TLS proxy only!). Required for voice over the internet.

variables.name: Voice Media Port (UDP)
variables.description: The one UDP port all WebRTC media flows over (ICE_UDP_MUX_PORT). Must match an extra UDP port allocation.

variables.name: ICE Advertise IP
variables.description: Public IP(s) advertised in ICE candidates, comma-separated (e.g. 203.0.113.10, 203.0.113.11). Leave empty if STUN auto-discovery works. Set your public IP if the server runs behind NAT or voice does not work.

variables.name: Max Voice Peers
variables.description: How many peers may be connected to the SFU at once.

variables.name: STUN Servers
variables.description: Comma-separated STUN URIs for NAT traversal.

variables.name: CORS Origins
variables.description: Allowed origins, comma-separated. Keep http://127.0.0.1:15738 (desktop app) and https://app.gryt.chat (hosted web client).

variables.name: Identity Tiers
variables.description: Comma-separated identity types the server accepts: account (Gryt account) and/or local (no account).

variables.name: External Host
variables.description: URL clients use to reach this server, e.g. http://203.0.113.10:5000

variables.name: Image Worker
variables.description: Run the image worker (thumbnails, recompression, voice tile colors). true or false.

variables.name: Disable STUN
variables.description: Stop the SFU from discovering its public IP via STUN. Only use with a direct, port-preserving path to the internet and set ICE_ADVERTISE_IP instead. true or false.

install.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Gryt Server (self-hosted Linux bundle) installation script

set -e

cd /mnt/server

## The Gryt Linux bundle is x86_64 only
if [ "$(uname -m)" != "x86_64" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: This egg requires an x86_64 (amd64) node, this one is $(uname -m)."
    echo "Gryt only publishes x64 self-hosted bundles (the gryt_sfu binary cannot run here)."
    exit 1
fi

## Resolve the release to install
if [ -z "${GRYT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${GRYT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Gryt release..."
    RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/Gryt-chat/server/releases/latest)
    RESOLVED_VERSION=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.tag_name | ltrimstr("v")')
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | test("^gryt-server-linux-x64-v[0-9].*\\.zip$")) | .browser_download_url')
else
    RESOLVED_VERSION="${GRYT_VERSION#v}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Gryt-chat/server/releases/download/v${RESOLVED_VERSION}/gryt-server-linux-x64-v${RESOLVED_VERSION}.zip"
fi

if [ -z "${RESOLVED_VERSION}" ] || [ "${RESOLVED_VERSION}" = "null" ] || [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Could not resolve a Gryt release for version '${GRYT_VERSION}'."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing Gryt Server v${RESOLVED_VERSION} (linux-x64 bundle)"

## Download and extract the bundle
echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL} ..."
curl -sSL --fail -o /mnt/server/gryt.zip "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

unzip -q -o /mnt/server/gryt.zip -d /mnt/server
cp -a /mnt/server/gryt-server-linux-x64/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/gryt-server-linux-x64 /mnt/server/gryt.zip

## Unused bundle wrappers (the egg starts node/gryt_sfu directly)
rm -f /mnt/server/start.bat /mnt/server/gryt_server.bat /mnt/server/gryt_image_worker.bat \
      /mnt/server/gryt_server.sh /mnt/server/gryt_image_worker.sh

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server/dist/index.js ] || [ ! -f /mnt/server/gryt_sfu ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Bundle seems incomplete (server/dist/index.js or gryt_sfu missing)."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/gryt_sfu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

echo "Installation of Gryt Server v${RESOLVED_VERSION} complete."
exit 0
